'''The Islands of the Dead''' is the [[Sea Folk]] name of the [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan continent]].

The Sea Folk refuse to cross the [[Aryth Ocean]] and only refer to what lies on the other side as the Islands of the Dead, "from which no ship returns." One known reference exists to "lands under the [[Shadow]], beyond the setting sun, beyond the Aryth Ocean, where the [[Armies of Night]] reign."{{ref/book|2|7}}
